replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
The only thing I see wrong is that someone (Dothraki) was knocked out of the world by a spectator (_iTobiaSPvP). It is not a bug, and as far as I know it is not punishable, unless they did it for malicious reasons. Judging by this, iTobiaS simply left the match/server, or even MC, therefore showing him as an observer, since he was not on a team. That's why you were not able to Tab his name.

Correct me if I'm wrong, that's what I assume you're talking about. :P
